formulas.total_opex: transaction_expense + transaction_and_credit_losses + customer_support_and_operations + sales_and_marketing + technology_and_development + general_and_administrative + restructuring_and_other

revenue_yoy.description: Net revenue YoY growth rate vs Q-4

transaction_expense_margin_delta_bps.description: Transaction expense as % of net revenue, delta vs Q-4

transaction_credit_losses_margin_delta_b.description: Transaction and credit losses as % of net revenue, delta vs Q-4

customer_support_margin_delta_bps.description: Customer support and operations as % of net revenue, delta vs Q-4

sales_marketing_margin_delta_bps.description: Sales and marketing as % of net revenue, delta vs Q-4

technology_development_margin_delta_bps.description: Technology and development as % of net revenue, delta vs Q-4

general_administrative_margin_delta_bps.description: General and administrative as % of net revenue, delta vs Q-4

restructuring_and_other_abs.description: restructuring_and_other absolute dollar value for the target quarter (predict the amount directly; 0 if none expected)

other_income_net_abs.description: other_income_net absolute dollar value for the target quarter (predict the amount directly; 0 if none expected)

tax_rate.description: Effective GAAP tax rate for the target quarter (decimal, e.g. 0.14 = 14%; may be negative in a benefit quarter). Choose from the GAAP historical anchors provided; a discrete tax item can push it far from any of them.

shares_abs.description: shares: diluted weighted-average share count for the target quarter (predict the count directly; drifts slowly with buybacks/issuance).
